featured_reviews.name: SD
featured_reviews.review_text: Small fish market at borivali West babhai. Market needs proper infrastructure. Presently its like a cluster of shanties. No flooring no other amenities available for the sellers. Municipal authorities need to look into this.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: It's not a fish market well build, yes but good to go for a fishy foody. The fisher mavshi ate very humble. You need to have good bargaining skills. Else 90% fish is fresh.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: You will get variety of fish over here. If you are bargaining king then you will surely get fish at good price. Bhav kami kelach pahije 😀

featured_reviews.name: Kishor Ubale
featured_reviews.review_text: The Fish Market is okay. This is located on Lokmanya Tilak Road mainly said as LT road. I think maximum level of cleanliness is not there but it is obvious we cannot find much cleanliness in place like this as it is a Fish Market. But is small in comparison with Fish Market of Gorai. But What you think about the place is more important. 👍🙌🙌😁

featured_reviews.name: Y V
featured_reviews.review_text: Wide variety of fresh fishes available here. This place is cleaner than any other fish markets around. They open up early at 8 am. There are a lot of cats and kittens here so you can even come here to adopt one if needed.

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Phatak
featured_reviews.review_text: Fresh fish available in vide veraity. Crabs also available. And you can also buy chicken.

featured_reviews.name: baron richie
featured_reviews.review_text: It's nice and accessible via road. Fish is of good quality. Cost is avg or higher side. Cleanliness is less. Expect murk and kichad in rainy season. You may find people lifting their outfits in order to save it from getting soiled
